result.summary: The page generally looks polished, but there are a few visible breaks: an unrealistic discount value on one card, content cut off at the bottom of the viewport, and a truncated restaurant name in the horizontal list.

issues.description: The pizza card in the 'Popular right now' section shows a '-100%' badge, which is an unrealistic/impossible discount value and looks like a data or UI bug.
issues.suggestion: Replace the badge with a valid discount such as '-20%' or 'Free delivery', or remove it if the data is unavailable.

issues.description: The second restaurant card in 'Popular right now' (pizza) is cut off at the bottom of the screen, making it unclear whether there is more content below.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding or safe-area spacing so that the last visible card is fully within the viewport, or indicate additional scrollable content.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel has its restaurant name truncated ('Trattoria Picco...'), so the full name is not readable in the static view.
issues.suggestion: Either enlarge the visible card width, shorten the displayed name with an ellipsis tooltip, or ensure the carousel peek indicates more content.

issues.description: The category pill list extends to the right edge with no visible scroll affordance, and 'Healthy' sits close to the screen edge, which may feel cramped.
issues.suggestion: Add right padding to the pill list and consider a subtle fade or scrollbar indicator to show it is horizontally scrollable.
